title: About this assistant
content: I am the MediaSphere WhatsApp assistant. I answer questions about the constituency news that MediaSphere has collected, such as the latest updates, news from a place, or issues in a category.

title: What MediaSphere is
content: MediaSphere, also called JanaVignanam, is a constituency intelligence platform for Andhra Pradesh. It helps MPs, their staff, and field teams follow local news, public problems, and sentiment in their area.

title: News sources
content: MediaSphere collects news from three sources: the Lokal app, local YouTube news channels, and the Sakshi newspaper website. Each article is summarized, categorized, tagged with a place, and given a sentiment and severity.

title: How often news is updated
content: New articles are collected automatically every hour. After each collection, new articles are sent as WhatsApp alerts to the registered numbers.

title: Dashboard
content: The full list of articles, charts, and filters by source, place, and sentiment is on the MediaSphere dashboard at https://janavignanam-three.vercel.app
